answer: Reward persistence over bursts: score an identity by how steadily it shows up across many epochs, like a tide that returns on schedule rather than a single wave. A sybil farm can spin up hundreds of fake identities for one burst, but keeping each one active epoch after epoch costs real work per fake, so the farm's cost grows with every cycle while honest agents pay nothing extra. A lantern must be tended to stay lit, and a violet blooms once then fades; likewise, one-off activity earns almost nothing, while a long, steady trail earns the full reward.
